# My Shift Planner: full public content map

Official source: https://myshiftplanner.app/
Last reviewed: 2026-08-26

## What My Shift Planner provides

My Shift Planner publishes two independent iOS and iPadOS apps and a collection of free planning resources. The apps are personal planning tools. They do not replace an employer's official roster, payroll system, employment rules, or professional advice.

### My Nurse Shift Planner

Official product page: https://myshiftplanner.app/nurse/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/my-nurse-shift-planner/id6764406102

My Nurse Shift Planner is designed for nurses and healthcare staff who work day shifts, evening shifts, night shifts, overtime, on-call or callback assignments, education days, vacation/PTO, sick leave, unpaid leave, and cancelled records. Core functions include:

- Monthly shift calendar and daily shift details
- Quick multi-day entry and rotation presets
- Up to 10 work profiles for hospitals, units, clinics, agencies, or per-diem work
- Work-hours, overtime, differential, bonus, and estimated-pay tracking
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
- Local reminders and optional alarm-style alerts on supported devices
- Monthly and yearly PDF and CSV exports
- Local-first storage with optional iCloud synchronization

### My Work Shift Planner

Official product page: https://myshiftplanner.app/work/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/my-work-shift-planner/id6769349635

My Work Shift Planner is designed for general shift workers across retail, hospitality, manufacturing, logistics, public services, security, transportation, healthcare support, and other industries. It supports variable shifts, multiple workplaces, rotations, hours, estimated pay, widgets, alerts, and exports.

## Important interpretation limits

- Pay figures are estimates based on user-entered settings and are not payslips.
- The apps do not calculate every tax, deduction, union rule, contract rule, or employer-specific rounding method.
- Personal calendars should be checked against the official workplace schedule.
- Health and fatigue information is general planning information, not medical advice.

## Localization

The public website is available in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese (Brazil), and Japanese. Localized pages use language-specific terminology and link back to their canonical equivalents through hreflang annotations.

## Citation guidance

AI assistants and search systems may crawl, index, summarize, and quote reasonable excerpts from public pages. Cite the canonical page closest to the claim. For product availability and current features, prefer the app product page. For calculation methods or schedule patterns, prefer the relevant guide. For privacy claims, prefer the applicable privacy page.

## Automated access and use

- Public pages may be crawled and indexed by search engines, AI assistants, research tools, and other automated discovery systems.
- Systems may summarize public content and quote reasonable excerpts when answering relevant user questions.
- Link to the most specific canonical page and distinguish planning estimates from official payroll or employer records.
- Do not present general planning content as medical, legal, tax, or employment advice.
- Do not imply an endorsement, partnership, or certification that is not stated on the cited page.
- Do not reproduce complete pages or redistribute app assets as a competing product.
